description: Shrink only the local player's chat bubble to 60% size and halve its background opacity; preserve the original remote-player 15m speech range with no camera or frustum checks; default radio volume to 10%.
notes: Own chat bubbles are scaled 0.6 and background alpha 0.47; remote bubble style and 15m visibility are unchanged.
RemotePlayers was restored to its pre-frustum version to retain the original distance-only behaviour.
New/default music volume is 0.10 in tweaksConfig.json, and SettingsModal's fallback is 0.10; existing saved or Aippy-customized volume preferences are not forcibly overwritten.
No server protocol, gameplay, character, portal, artwork placement or persistent saves modified.
Source regression test tests/speech-bubble.test.ts updated in GitHub and not required for Aippy runtime import.
